Calling the required libraries

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| output: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false

list_p <- c("tidyverse", "readxl", "soiltexture", 
            "readr", "caret", "plotly", "ggsignif", 
            "reactable")

sapply(list_p, function(x) {
       if(!require(x, character.only = TRUE)) {
         install.packages(x, dependencies = TRUE)
         library(x, character.only = TRUE)
       }
       })
```

Uploading the required information

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: fasle
#| output: false
#| warning: false

FR_yield <- read_excel("D:\\OneDrive - CGIAR\\Fertilize Right ADMIN\\ACTIVIDADES\\A3. LB Suelos\\Analisis/Rendimientos.xlsx", 
                       na = c("null", NA), sheet = "Sheet1") |>
            dplyr::select(Finca, Tratamiento, Variedad, 
                          Rendimiento_kg_ha...7, "% Granos_llenos", "%Vaneamiento") |> 
            mutate(Tratamiento = factor(Tratamiento, levels = c("Convencional", "Optimizado", "Alternativo"))) |>
            rename(Yield = "Rendimiento_kg_ha...7") |>
            as.data.frame()


```

Let's get the statistics table to observe the differences between the treatments

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: fasle
#| output: false
#| warning: false

FR_yield |> 
    group_by(Tratamiento) |> 
    summarize(
        "%_llenos" = mean(`% Granos_llenos`, na.rm = TRUE), 
        "%_llenos_sd" = sd(`% Granos_llenos`, na.rm = TRUE),
        "%_vaneados" = mean(`%Vaneamiento`, na.rm = TRUE),
        "%_vaneados_sd" = sd(`%Vaneamiento`, na.rm = TRUE), 
        Yield_mean = mean(Yield, na.rm = TRUE),
        Yield_sd = sd(Yield, na.rm = TRUE))

anova <- aov(`% Granos_llenos` ~ Tratamiento, data = FR_yield)
summary(anova)
TukeyHSD(anova, "Tratamiento")

broom::tidy(anova)

```
